lamps.flashing: Slow blinking indicates normal left turn operation. Fast blinking indicates a fused left turn bulb that needs replacing.
Slow blinking indicates normal right turn operation. Fast blinking indicates a fused right turn bulb that needs replacing.

lamps.steady: Indicates the vehicle is in cruise mode.
lamps.flashing: Blinking indicates the accelerator is pressed to temporarily override cruise mode for overtaking.

lamps.steady: Indicates a fault in the Automatic Emergency Braking system. Contact a Mahindra authorized dealer immediately.
Indicates water accumulated in the fuel filter. Drain the filter or contact a Mahindra authorized dealer.
Indicates an engine immobilizer system malfunction. Contact a Mahindra authorized dealer immediately.
lamps.flashing: Slow blinking means vehicle is armed. Fast blinking indicates an immobilizer system malfunction.

lamps.steady: Indicates an ABS malfunction. Normal brakes still work, but wheels may lock. Contact a Mahindra dealer.

lamps.lamp: Park Brake / EBD / Low Brake Fluid Telltale
lamps.steady: Indicates parking brake is engaged, low brake fluid, EBD malfunction, or worn brake pads. Contact dealer immediately.
Indicates the parking lamps are switched on.
Indicates an airbag system malfunction. Contact a Mahindra authorized dealer immediately.
lamps.flashing: Indicates an airbag system malfunction if it flashes intermittently while driving.

lamps.steady: Indicates a malfunction in the Hill Hold Control system. Contact a Mahindra authorized dealer immediately.
Indicates that one or more doors, the hood, or the boot are open.
Indicates fuel level has reached the reserve limit. Refuel immediately.
lamps.flashing: Indicates fuel is extremely low. Refuel immediately.

lamps.steady: Indicates the Electronic Stability Program has been manually switched off.
Indicates a malfunction in the ESP system. Contact a Mahindra authorized dealer immediately.
lamps.flashing: Blinking indicates the ESP system is actively controlling the vehicle's stability.

lamps.steady: Indicates the front fog lamps are switched on.
Indicates low/high tire pressure, high temperature, or an air leak.
lamps.flashing: Blinking for 90 seconds followed by steady light indicates a system or sensor malfunction.

lamps.steady: Reminds the driver to fasten their seat belt. Contact a dealer if it stays on after fastening.
Indicates low DEF level, incorrect DEF fluid, or a dosing malfunction. Refer to the emissions manual.
Indicates DPF regeneration has not occurred. Drive on a highway to clear it or follow emissions instructions.
lamps.flashing: Indicates DPF park regeneration must be performed immediately.

lamps.steady: Indicates glow plugs are active. Contact a dealer if it illuminates while driving.
Indicates the high beams are switched on or being flashed.
Potential emission or fuel management system malfunction if on while engine runs. Contact dealer immediately.
lamps.flashing: Indicates a potential emission control system malfunction. Contact a Mahindra authorized dealer immediately.

lamps.steady: Indicates Electronic Power Steering malfunction. Steering will require increased effort. Contact dealer immediately.

lamps.lamp: Low Engine Oil Pressure Warning telltale
lamps.steady: Indicates dangerously low oil pressure. Stop immediately, check level, top up, or contact a dealer.
Indicates a potential engine management system malfunction. Turn off engine and contact a dealer immediately.
lamps.flashing: Blinking indicates a fault in the engine management system. Stop immediately and contact a dealer.

lamps.steady: Indicates battery is not charging or alternator malfunction. Turn off extra electricals and contact dealer.

lamps.lamp: High Engine Coolant Temperature Warning telltale
lamps.steady: Engine temperature is critically high (115C or above). Stop immediately and contact a dealer.
lamps.flashing: Flashes when engine coolant temperature exceeds 113C. Stop safely to prevent engine damage.

lamps.steady: Indicates manual DPF regeneration is required.
lamps.flashing: Indicates manual DPF regeneration is currently in progress.

lamps.steady: Indicates transmission component or sensor malfunction. Contact a Mahindra dealer immediately.
lamps.flashing: Indicates clutch overheating due to abuse. Reduce speed until the lamp turns off.

lamps.steady: Indicates a malfunction in the Hill Descent Control system. Contact a Mahindra dealer.
Indicates the rear fog lamps are switched on.
Indicates the engine is currently in auto-stop mode.
lamps.flashing: Blinking indicates auto-stop is imminent. Fast blinking indicates auto-stop is disabled due to weak battery.

lamps.lamp: Automatic Emergency Braking System OFF telltale
lamps.steady: Indicates the AEB system is deactivated by the user.
Indicates LKA is in standby, active, or has malfunctioned. If failed, contact a dealer.
lamps.flashing: Blinking indicates the system is warning the driver, or the camera is uncalibrated.

lamps.steady: Indicates LDW is in standby, active, or has malfunctioned. If failed, contact a dealer.
lamps.flashing: Blinking indicates the system is warning the driver, or the camera is uncalibrated.

lamps.steady: Indicates standby, active, or failed state. If failed, contact a dealer.
lamps.flashing: Blinking indicates the system is transiting to standby and stopping steering assistance.

lamps.steady: Indicates standby, active, temporary blockage/unavailability, or malfunction. If failed, contact a dealer.
Indicates auto high beam booster is active above 80 km/h.
Indicates high beam assist is enabled and active.
Indicates standby, active, or failed state. If failed, contact a dealer.
Indicates a malfunction in the All-Wheel Drive system. Contact a Mahindra dealer.
Indicates a malfunction in the Electric Parking Brake. Contact a Mahindra dealer immediately.
